title: The Unwritten Uniform
author: Astrid Reyes
blurb: Kestrel Dravenmoor, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
